project.delete.note: deletes a project created for it (as its console owner); the data is removed in the background

project.keys.create.note: as the console user: an API key may not create keys

project.mockPhones.delete.note: a mock phone shares the project's `auths` with the policies, written read-modify-write: a concurrent policy update can drop the number first, then this answers 404

project.smtp.update.note: checks the server (the dev stack's mail catcher) before saving

project.smtp.tests.create.note: queues the test mail; the mails worker sends it to the dev stack's mail catcher
